plan.concept: RANSAC algorithm outlier rejection and final line fitting to inlier points
plan.layout: single panel labeled (f) at the bottom center

panels.label: (f)

series.label: Inliers
series.note: Light blue circular markers with a solid black outline representing the selected inlier data points

series.label: Outliers
series.note: White circular markers with a solid black outline representing the rejected outlier data points

series.label: Fitted Line
series.note: Thick red line representing the final consensus model line

panels.nodeDecorations: Data points are circles with black borders. Inliers have a sky-blue fill (#59C3FF) and outliers have a white fill.

plan.colorScheme: White background, black axes, red regression line (#FF0000), sky-blue inliers (#59C3FF), and white outliers (#FFFFFF) with black borders
plan.reconstructionNotes: Ensure the axes have arrowheads at the positive ends. The label '(f)' is positioned centered below the horizontal axis. The line should pass close to the blue points and ignore the white points completely.
